Für Kunst und künstlerische Gestaltung in jeder Form hatte ich schon immer großes Interesse. Etwa vor 30 Jahren fing ich an, selbst hobbymäßig künstlerisch tätig zu werden, zunächst mit Seidenmalerei. Nach einigen Jahren hatte ich genug Tücher bemalt im Schrank und an gute Freundinnen und Verwandte verschenkt und versuchte dann zuerst auf Seide Bilder zu malen. Dies ist nicht leicht, weil die Seide sehr fließend ist. So kam ich auf die Idee lieber auf Papier bzw. Leinwand malen lernen zu wollen.

43→ 44→

Den ersten Kunstkurs besuchte ich im Frühjahr 2000 – zum Thema Aquarellmalerei. Später folgten noch viele Kurse bei sehr unterschiedlichen Künstlern hier aus der Region, die meine zeichnerischen- und maltechnischen Fähigkeiten verbessert haben. Diese Künstler haben nicht nur Mal- und Zeichentechniken vermittelt, sondern auch Farbenlehre, Bildaufbau, Proportionen, den Blick auf ein Kunstwerk, die Perspektive des Malers und vieles mehr.

Aus diesem Grund sind die meisten meiner Bilder in Acryl und auch in Mischtechniken gemalt, zum Teil auch mit Struktur- und Kollagen-Elementen versehen.

1→# Specification: Photo Gallery Integration with Responsive Images
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→This task integrates a responsive photo gallery feature from the reference project (tannerdolby/eleventy-photo-gallery) into the Rita Tomforde portfolio website. The implementation will add the `@11ty/eleventy-img` plugin for automatic image optimization and responsive image generation, download sample images from the reference repository, and create a dedicated photo gallery page with modern responsive image techniques.
     6→
     7→## Workflow Type
     8→
     9→**Type**: feature
    10→
    11→**Rationale**: This task adds new functionality to an existing Eleventy site by integrating a complete photo gallery system with image processing capabilities. It requires installing new dependencies, creating new templates and data files, and adding CSS styles - typical of a feature implementation workflow.
    12→
    13→## Task Scope
    14→
    15→### Services Involved
    16→- **main** (primary) - The Eleventy static site generator that will process templates and images
    17→
    18→### This Task Will:
    19→- [ ] Install `@11ty/eleventy-img` package for image processing
    20→- [ ] Configure image shortcode/plugin in `eleventy.config.js`
    21→- [ ] Download sample images from the reference repository to `src/images/gallery/`
    22→- [ ] Create `src/_data/gallery.json` with image metadata for the photo gallery
    23→- [ ] Create `src/gallery.njk` template for the photo gallery page
    24→- [ ] Add responsive gallery CSS styles to `src/css/styles.css`
    25→- [ ] Add navigation link to the gallery page in `src/_includes/nav.njk`
    26→
    27→### Out of Scope:
    28→- Lightbox functionality (can be added later)
    29→- Individual image detail pages (feature.njk pattern)
    30→- SCSS preprocessing (project uses plain CSS)
    31→- Social media meta tags (eleventy-plugin-metagen)
    32→- Complex navigation plugins
    33→
    34→## Service Context
    35→
    36→### Main (Eleventy Site)
    37→
    38→**Tech Stack:**
    39→- Language: JavaScript
    40→- Framework: Eleventy v3.0.0
    41→- Template Engine: Nunjucks (.njk)
    42→- Key directories: `src/`, `src/_data/`, `src/_includes/`, `src/css/`, `src/images/`
    43→
    44→**Entry Point:** `eleventy.config.js`
    45→
    46→**How to Run:**
    47→```bash
    48→npm run dev
    49→```
    50→
    51→**Port:** 8080 (Eleventy default)
    52→
    53→**Build Command:**
    54→```bash
    55→npm run build
    56→```
    57→
    58→## Files to Modify
    59→
    60→| File | Service | What to Change |
    61→|------|---------|---------------|
    62→| `eleventy.config.js` | main | Add eleventy-img plugin configuration and async image shortcode |
    63→| `src/css/styles.css` | main | Add photo gallery grid styles with responsive layout |
    64→| `src/_includes/nav.njk` | main | Add navigation link to the new gallery page |
    65→| `package.json` | main | Will be updated automatically by npm install |
    66→
    67→## Files to Create
    68→
    69→| File | Service | Purpose |
    70→|------|---------|---------|
    71→| `src/_data/gallery.json` | main | Image metadata array for the photo gallery |
    72→| `src/gallery.njk` | main | Photo gallery page template |
    73→| `src/images/gallery/*.jpg` | main | Downloaded sample images from reference repo |
    74→
    75→## Files to Reference
    76→
    77→These files show patterns to follow:
    78→
    79→| File | Pattern to Copy |
    80→|------|----------------|
    81→| `src/_data/paintings.json` | Existing data structure pattern for JSON data files |
    82→| `src/index.njk` | Template structure with layout, sections, and data iteration |
    83→| `src/css/styles.css` | CSS variable usage, gallery-grid class patterns |
    84→| `src/_includes/nav.njk` | Navigation link structure |
    85→
    86→## Patterns to Follow
    87→
    88→### 1. Data File Structure Pattern
    89→
    90→From `src/_data/paintings.json`:
    91→
    92→```json
    93→{
    94→  "paintings": [
    95→    {
    96→      "id": "painting-1",
    97→      "title": "Blumenwiese",
    98→      "image": "/images/gallery/painting-1.jpg",
    99→      "description": "Eine farbenfrohe Darstellung...",
   100→      "technique": "Acryl auf Leinwand",
   101→      "year": 2024,
   102→      "available": true
   103→    }
   104→  ]
   105→}
   106→```
   107→
   108→**Key Points:**
   109→- Use descriptive field names in German where appropriate for this German-language site
   110→- Include alt text (description) for accessibility
   111→- Group items under a named array property
   112→
   113→### 2. Gallery JSON Schema (from reference project)
   114→
   115→```json
   116→{
   117→  "images": [
   118→    {
   119→      "src": "highway-water.jpg",
   120→      "alt": "Skybridge over highway covered in water",
   121→      "title": "Highway covered in water",
   122→      "credit": "Photo by Josh Hild",
   123→      "linkToAuthor": "https://www.pexels.com/..."
   124→    }
   125→  ]
   126→}
   127→```
   128→
   129→**Key Points:**
   130→- `src` is just the filename (directory is configured in shortcode)
   131→- `alt` text is required and must be descriptive
   132→- Include credit attribution for stock photos
   133→
   134→### 3. Eleventy Image Shortcode Pattern
   135→
   136→From research findings - register as Nunjucks async shortcode:
   137→
   138→```javascript
   139→const Image = require("@11ty/eleventy-img");
   140→
   141→async function imageShortcode(src, alt, widths = [300, 600, 900], sizes = "(min-width: 400px) 33.3vw, 100vw") {
   142→  if (!alt) {
   143→    throw new Error(`Missing alt text for image: ${src}`);
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  let metadata = await Image(src, {
   147→    widths: widths,
   148→    formats: ["webp", "jpeg"],
   149→    outputDir: "./_site/img/",
   150→    urlPath: "/rita-tomforde/img/"
   151→  });
   152→
   153→  return Image.generateHTML(metadata, {
   154→    alt,
   155→    sizes,
   156→    loading: "lazy",
   157→    decoding: "async"
   158→  });
   159→}
   160→
   161→module.exports = function(eleventyConfig) {
   162→  eleventyConfig.addNunjucksAsyncShortcode("image", imageShortcode);
   163→};
   164→```
   165→
   166→**Key Points:**
   167→- Must be registered as **async Nunjucks shortcode** (`addNunjucksAsyncShortcode`)
   168→- Validate alt text presence
   169→- Use `urlPath` with the project's path prefix (`/rita-tomforde/`)
   170→- Include `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` for performance
   171→
   172→### 4. CSS Grid Pattern for Gallery
   173→
   174→From existing `src/css/styles.css` gallery pattern:
   175→
   176→```css
   177→.gallery-grid {
   178→    display: grid;
   179→    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
   180→    gap: var(--spacing-md);
   181→}
   182→
   183→.gallery-item {
   184→    background-color: var(--color-background);
   185→    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
   186→    overflow: hidden;
   187→    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
   188→    transition: transform var(--transition-fast), box-shadow var(--transition-fast);
   189→}
   190→```
   191→
   192→**Key Points:**
   193→- Use CSS custom properties from the existing design system
   194→- Use CSS Grid with `auto-fill` for responsive columns
   195→- Include hover transitions for interactivity
   196→
   197→## Requirements
   198→
   199→### Functional Requirements
   200→
   201→1. **Responsive Image Generation**
   202→   - Description: Images are automatically processed at build time to generate multiple sizes and formats (WebP + JPEG)
   203→   - Acceptance: Build generates responsive variants in `_site/img/` directory
   204→
   205→2. **Photo Gallery Page**
   206→   - Description: Dedicated page displaying sample images in a responsive grid layout
   207→   - Acceptance: Gallery page accessible at `/gallery/` with all images visible
   208→
   209→3. **Image Optimization**
   210→   - Description: All gallery images include lazy loading and async decoding attributes
   211→   - Acceptance: Generated `<picture>` elements include `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"`
   212→
   213→4. **Alt Text Validation**
   214→   - Description: All images must have alt text for accessibility
   215→   - Acceptance: Build fails if any image is missing alt text
   216→
   217→5. **Navigation Integration**
   218→   - Description: Gallery page is accessible from main navigation
   219→   - Acceptance: "Galerie" link in navigation leads to the gallery page
   220→
   221→### Edge Cases
   222→
   223→1. **Missing Image File** - Build should fail gracefully with clear error message
   224→2. **Invalid Image Format** - Only process supported formats (jpg, png, webp)
   225→3. **SVG Images** - Should pass through without raster processing (use svgShortCircuit)
   226→4. **Very Large Images** - Resize to reasonable maximum width (e.g., 1200px)
   227→5. **Empty Gallery Data** - Display appropriate message when no images in gallery.json
   228→
   229→## Implementation Notes
   230→
   231→### DO
   232→- Follow the pattern in `src/_data/paintings.json` for data structure
   233→- Reuse CSS custom properties from `src/css/styles.css`
   234→- Use the existing `.gallery-grid` class pattern for layout
   235→- Include `pathPrefix` in `urlPath` for GitHub Pages compatibility
   236→- Use WebP with JPEG fallback for browser compatibility
   237→- Add `loading="lazy"` for performance
   238→- Validate alt text in the shortcode
   239→
   240→### DON'T
   241→- Don't use AVIF format (expensive build time, not needed)
   242→- Don't create new CSS variables when existing ones work
   243→- Don't modify existing gallery section on index.njk (separate page)
   244→- Don't use transform plugin if shortcode gives more control needed
   245→- Don't skip image credits/attribution for stock photos

   253→npm install @11ty/eleventy-img
   254→
   255→# Start development server
   256→npm run dev
   257→```

   133→
   134→### 3. Eleventy Image Shortcode Pattern
   135→
   136→From research findings - register as Nunjucks async shortcode:
   137→
   138→```javascript
   139→const Image = require("@11ty/eleventy-img");
   140→
   141→async function imageShortcode(src, alt, widths = [300, 600, 900], sizes = "(min-width: 400px) 33.3vw, 100vw") {
   142→  if (!alt) {
   143→    throw new Error(`Missing alt text for image: ${src}`);
   144→  }
   145→
   146→  let metadata = await Image(src, {
   147→    widths: widths,
   148→    formats: ["webp", "jpeg"],
   149→    outputDir: "./_site/img/",
   150→    urlPath: "/rita-tomforde/img/"
   151→  });
   152→
   153→  return Image.generateHTML(metadata, {
   154→    alt,
   155→    sizes,
   156→    loading: "lazy",
   157→    decoding: "async"
   158→  });
   159→}
   160→
   161→module.exports = function(eleventyConfig) {
   162→  eleventyConfig.addNunjucksAsyncShortcode("image", imageShortcode);
   163→};
   164→```
   165→
   166→**Key Points:**
   167→- Must be registered as **async Nunjucks shortcode** (`addNunjucksAsyncShortcode`)
   168→- Validate alt text presence
   169→- Use `urlPath` with the project's path prefix (`/rita-tomforde/`)
   170→- Include `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` for performance
